---
title: "Shaduw langs de snelweg"
---

Shade detection at roadside stops (EU) from open satellite data. For a set of
stopping places along highways (rest areas, service stations, parkings) the
pipeline estimates **how shaded each stop is**, including seasonal variation,
using only openly available data: Sentinel-2 imagery, the ETH global canopy
height model and OpenStreetMap. Developed by HKV, published under GNU GPL-3.

See the plan (`shade-detection-pipeline-plan.md`) for the full design, and the
API reference for the pipeline modules.

Quick start:

```bash
pixi install
pixi run shaduw run --config configs/nl-prototype.toml
```
